scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun run --cwd apps/server build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/client typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/client/dist apps/server/dist packages/shared/dist apps/client/.vite apps/server/.vite .vite node_modules/.vite apps/server/data/memory-store.json
scripts.clean:all: bun run clean && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lock
